messages:
arjun: Quick sync: we saw an uptick in trace spans missing tenant attribution in the multi-model routing path. Correlates with a refactor yesterday.

sophie: which refactor? the route-key normalization?

arjun: yes—route-key now canonicalizes model_id and variant into a single routing_key, but we lost the original tenant_tag in the impl because of a proto rename.

maria: are those spans completely un-attributed or did we get a fallback?

arjun: fallback path sets tenant_id=unknown. that breaks billing joins and SLO dashboards.

ken: temporary mitigation: ingest gateway can run a tenant-lookup by source IP -> tenant map for recent IP assignments. not great but helps.

sophie: long-term: we need an invariant that certain attribution fields survive refactors: tenant_id, request_id, billing_key. add a lint/check in proto evolution.

arjun: proposing proto-lint rule: any rename of fields in envelopes must include an alias mapping and a migration hook. also CI should run a small sanity replay test to ensure tenant attribution preserved.

maria: agree. also add telemetry for 'attr_loss' with counts per service and per commit so rollbacks are faster.

ken: operational playbook: if attr_loss > 0.1% for >5 min, trigger pager and auto-rollout-block on the last prod deployment.

sophie: about migration hook: the proto registry should keep named aliases and we should implement a lightweight adapter in the ingest layer that maps old->new names during transition windows.

arjun: implementation idea: proto-evolution table with entries: service, old_field, new_field, deadline. ingest-layer consults table at startup and applies mapper functions.

maria: edge-case: private deployments with offline control plane won't see proto registry updates. need a versioned on-disk alias file customers can opt into.

ops-bot: Run "replay-smoke" triggered for commit a7f3c2 by arjun at 2026-01-09T09:10:01Z - result: 12 attr_loss events found

ken: replay shows a handful of services that missed mapping. we should hotfix ingest gateway to check common aliases for tenant_id and billing_key.

sophie: also add unit tests for proto rename with round-trip serialization tests. catchers in CI.

arjun: timeline: hotfix today; proto-lint and adapter in 2 sprints; registry + on-disk alias file next quarter.

maria: I'll notify product and finance of the temporary mitigation. add a retrospective note in the postmortems channel once we finish.

ken: assigning: arjun -> hotfix; sophie -> proto-lint rule + CI test; maria -> stakeholder comms. tag me for the rollout blocker config.

arjun: on it. hotfix PR up in 10.

maria: thanks everyone.
